heightEncoding: Signed int16 little-endian metres, rows north to south and columns west to east; bounds included; no vertical exaggeration
normalEncoding: OpenGL tangent-space RGB in linear colour space; red=east, green=north, blue=up; pixel centres; no vertical exaggeration
operations: Bilinear geographic resampling of the two source grids
Round surface elevations to integral metres
Differentiate unexaggerated elevations at 1024 pixel centres for the normal map
source: NASA/NGA SRTM one-arcsecond elevation, distributed by USGS and the Mapzen/Tilezen Terrain Tiles AWS mirror; a distribution mosaic, not an original NASA download
licence: Public-domain U.S. government terrain; source attribution retained
attribution: SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; NASA/NGA. Distribution: Mapzen/Tilezen Terrain Tiles, AWS Open Data.
